description:
Burn-after-reading encrypted notes.

BurnPony for the desktop is burn-after-reading encrypted notes, compiled from the same crypto engine the phone apps ship, with a full command line. Create a note, share its link, and it self-deletes once the read limit or expiry is reached.
Full Changelog: https://github.com/norsehorse-dev/BurnPonyDesktop/compare/v1.0.0...v1.1.0
